items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: the owner of the club, Sol Tenenbaum, announced over the other mike... Sol Tenenbaum says, 'This Monday and Tuesday, the Wilbur Ware Trio!'

ctx.x: Cherokee, yeah. (Unintelligible) Brownie, and Max, A.. just beautiful. And when we finished, Max got up with the microphone in his hand, and he went to say, "Ladies and gentlemen ..." -- and the owner of the club, Sol Tenenbaum, announced over the other mike, and this was Monday and Tuesday, which was the off nights; the club was running 7 nights a week with the regular group running from Tuesday until -- no,

from Wednesday until Sunday, and the alternate night trio or whatever, Monday and Tuesday. So he has the microphone and he is about to announce, you know, and Sol Tenenbaum says, "This Monday and Tuesday, the Wilbur Ware Trio!" And Max looked around and said, "You done played me up on my gig."
